name: Hyperleap AI
oneLiner: AI chatbot platform that answers guests on a website, WhatsApp, Instagram and Facebook Messenger from one knowledge base, with a restaurant 'AI front desk' package.
bestFor: Independent restaurants and small multi-location groups, especially in WhatsApp-first markets, that want an inexpensive AI chat assistant across web and messaging.

customers.name: Jungle Lodges & Resorts (Karnataka state tourism, India)

features: One AI agent deployed on website chat, WhatsApp (Business API), Instagram DM and Facebook Messenger
Answers grounded in your uploaded documents, menus and FAQs
Restaurant front-desk flows: menu, hours, dietary questions and sharing a reservation link
Routes allergy questions to staff instead of guessing
Collects event and large-party requests and captures leads
Shared knowledge base that can serve several locations
Studio and API add-on for custom builds

pricing.text: Plus $40/month, Pro $100/month, Max $200/month; each with a 7-day free trial (card required). AI response allowances differ between Hyperleap's own pages, so check the live pricing page.

notes: Only customer found is Jungle Lodges & Resorts (a resort group, not a restaurant), named on Hyperleap's own site; no independent coverage. Hyperleap's pages disagree on its results (40% vs 11% rise in direct bookings), so keep numbers out.
